gpt.rationale: The mostly subdued, uneasy sprites suit an introverted girl, but reusing uneasy_confused for relief, tentative acceptance, curiosity, and quiet humor misses many line-specific emotional turns.

claude.rationale: Aoi uses uneasy_confused for nearly every line regardless of context (shock at the key, relief after closing the portal, the final quip about homeroom), failing to show the subtle emotional modulation and restraint an introverted character would display; the single surprised sprite at the sigil mark is too little, too late to salvage the monotonous affect.
